name: solar-rooftop-calculator
description: Solar Rooftop Calculator - standalone app (Express API + React frontend)

scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix my-express-web-server && npm install --prefix frontend
